title: Cart total goes negative with FREESHIP coupon
body: Applying FREESHIP to a cart under $5 makes the total negative (e.g. a $3 cart shows -$2). cart_total calls apply_coupon, which subtracts 5 without clamping at zero. Started after the coupon refactor in #37.
